none: PAS NLM-AB4056: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Gloria Romanorum issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive; the imperial pose is especially active. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.9mm, Weight: 1.78gms, die…
